title: Small-set expansion event bound
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ take only the values $0$ and $1$, and suppose its uniform mean is $\alpha$. For $\rho\in[0,1]$, under the correlated-pair distribution at correlation $\rho$, the probability that both coordinates of the pair lie in the set where $f=1$ is at most $\alpha^{2/(1+\rho)}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
